tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Chili red fill: Single price chip, active category tab, primary button, the top strip. Text on it is `on-red` (6.4:1 light, 5.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red text on `surface-100` and `surface-200`: the Signature and Spicy labels, poster eyebrow and big fries prices. 6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `red`.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Ranch green fill: wooden plank section signs, the category strap, the footer, the poster frame and the checkerboard squares. Text on it is `on-green`.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green text on `surface-100`: the 'With fries' line, the Grilled label and small eyebrows. 5.2:1 light and 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on `green` (8.6:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brass accent only: plank nails, ★ stars and the plank kicker text. Never a background for text, and never more than a few marks per screen.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on `gold` on the rare gold button (the footer 'Copy number').

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Parchment page background. In dark mode it becomes a night-time saloon brown, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Deeper parchment: the wanted-poster panel and occasional bands.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Item names and body text on `surface-100` and `surface-200` (14:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Italic ingredient lines and captions on `surface-100` (6:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: rope
tokens.usage: Dashed dividers between menu items and around the chapter ticket. Decorative only.

tokens.name: floor
tokens.usage: Centre colour of the oval floor shadow under a cut-out sandwich (radial gradient to transparent). Nothing else.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a 3px solid outline with a 2px offset on every control.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The poster headline, once per page.

styles.name: plank
styles.usage: Section titles on the green planks, in title case and never uppercase (Rye is already loud).

styles.name: chapter
styles.usage: The chapter ticket and footer slogan.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Numbers inside price chips, with tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, tab labels, chip labels (SINGLE / DOUBLE) and badges.

styles.name: ingredients
styles.sample: Beef patty, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, mayo & ketchup
styles.usage: Ingredient lines in italic `ink-muted`, like handwritten saloon menus.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Chef Enzo is roaming America hunting for bold new recipes.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Prices in EGP. Every sandwich comes with fries.
styles.usage: Footnotes and the footer fine print.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: برجر لحمة بقري، خس، طماطم، بصل، مخلل، مايونيز وكاتشب
styles.usage: Arabic ingredients, upright (Arabic has no italic).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between price chips and tabs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Plank padding and chapter ticket padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter and checker square size.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Item vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above each section plank.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Price chips, tabs, buttons and the poster corners. Saloon signage is square-cut.

tokens.name: radius-plank
tokens.usage: Wooden plank section signs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The EN / ع language toggle and sauce chips only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The chapter badge medallion.

tokens.name: shadow-plank
tokens.usage: Under each wooden plank, so it reads as a board nailed to the wall.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The active red tab on the green strap.

tokens.name: shadow-strap
tokens.usage: Rope-coloured edge under the sticky category strap.
